# Is your price too low?

> Free price elasticity calculator for sellers. Paste your sales history (date, price, units) to estimate how demand reacts to price, get a confidence interval, the profit-maximising price within what you have tested, and a back-test that says whether to trust it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
